UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated student or young professional profile storing school/Google email, tier status, daily NicAI usage, and completed study module IDs.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

email.description: Google or Google Workspace school email address (PII, owner-only).

displayName.description: User display name from Google Sign-In.

accountType.description: Whether the signed-in email is a personal Gmail or a school/organization Google Workspace domain.

proActive.description: Whether NovaDeck Pro preview/plan is active.

completedModuleIds.description: List of completed Study Hub module IDs (max 50).

dailyPromptsUsed.description: Number of NicAI free prompts used on promptDate.

promptDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD local date key for daily free prompt quota.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (client sends FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (client sends FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CloudDeck.title: CloudDeck
CloudDeck.description: Presentation deck created or saved in Slide Studio under a user's personal subcollection.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the deck owner.

audience.description: Target audience label (e.g. SMP Students, SMA Students, Young Pro / Office).

aiGenerated.description: Whether this deck was generated via Gemini AI.

slides.description: Ordered list of slide maps (1 to 15 slides).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp on creation (client sends FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp on last update (client sends FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user profile, email, study progress, and quota state.

/users/{userId}/decks/{deckId}.description: Owner-isolated saved presentation decks synced across sessions.
